gold.title: HIV感染的肽衍生物融合抑制剂
gold.assignee: 前沿生物药业（南京）股份有限公司

silver.title: 新型冠状病毒Vero细胞灭活疫苗病毒液及其生产方法
silver.assignee: 北京生物制品研究所有限责任公司、中国生物技术股份有限公司

value_state.pre_t0_scale: 2021 sales RMB40.5029m; 111,834 units; >200 designated hospitals; >100 DTP pharmacies

attribution_evidence.E3: confirmed: regulated SSE disclosure explicitly places ZL03816434.5 inside Albuvirtide product technology and states that product technology is core to Aikening development
attribution_evidence.E4: unknown: no defensible standalone share of revenue/performance attributable only to this Chinese patent

value_state.product: BIBP-CorV / Beijing Institute inactivated COVID-19 vaccine
value_state.regulatory_status: conditionally approved in China before T0; WHO EUL in 2021
value_state.pre_t0_scale: global public-health deployment; COVAX agreement for up to 170m Beijing Institute doses

attribution_evidence.E3: strong evidence: patent claims a Vero-cell inactivated SARS-CoV-2 vaccine product; official NHC/WHO sources identify Beijing Institute's marketed vaccine as a Vero-cell inactivated product, but reviewed T0 sources do not provide an explicit patent-number-to-product table
attribution_evidence.E4: unknown: no standalone attributable share of vaccine public-health/economic value assigned to the patent
attribution_evidence.E5: official patent, NHC, WHO and COVAX-related sources

silver.observability_state: high at product/regulatory level; exact-patent linkage strong but not fully explicit
silver.realization_stage: R4 strong/confirmed at product level with strong exact-patent linkage; R5 unknown

result.key_observation: Both Gold and Silver had clear, large real-world health value before T0. The architecture avoids ranking them by scale and instead separates actual value, exact-patent attribution, evidence quality and observability. R5 remains unresolved on both sides.
